raw_text: BREAKING: Houthi forces appear to have seized a commercial vessel in the Red Sea. MV Galaxy Leader, a vehicle carrier with links to an Israeli businessman, went dark on AIS approximately 1 hour ago. Helicopter activity was tracked on open-source flight radar prior to the disappearance. The ship was transiting from Koper, Slovenia to Pipavav, India. Houthi military spokesperson has not yet issued a statement but Ansar Allah-affiliated channels are celebrating. This would be the first successful ship seizure by Houthi forces since the Gaza conflict escalation.
